job.title: Data Engineer II
job.description:
Atlas Aerospace builds avionics test systems. The data engineering group moves test-rig data into an analytics platform used by our engineers.

Responsibilities: build ETL and orchestration (Airflow); maintain the data warehouse (Snowflake); automate data quality checks; containerize jobs with Docker.

Requirements: Bachelor's in CS or IT; 5+ years of data engineering; Python, SQL, Spark; a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

Austin, TX.
